question: How many gold medals has India won in athletics till Paris Olympics 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India has won exactly **one gold medal** in **Athletics** in its entire Olympic history, up to and including the **Paris Olympics 2024**.
 
• This landmark achievement was recorded by **Neeraj Chopra** in the **Men's Javelin Throw** event during the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** (which took place in 2021 due to the pandemic).
